module.title: Care Organizations, Sites, Units, Spaces and Workforce
module.business_purpose: General physical and care-delivery infrastructure for a private office, clinic, medical center, hospital, nursing station, laboratory, imaging site, pharmacy counter, mobile unit or virtual service. Hospitals, diagnostic units and pharmacies receive explicit domain identities in specialized schemas. A site may host them without merging their tenants, credentials or data governance. The model implements Organization + Location + HealthcareService + PractitionerRole semantics without forcing every professional to own a room.
